# LRF-IMU

> Milestone 1 public-release boundary: portable configuration and audit references only.

## Paper identity

- Title: A latent rectified flow approach to generate synthetic wearable data – a LABDA solution
- Authors: Amin Rezaei; Morten Kjærgaard; Jasper Schipperijn
- Journal: Machine Learning: Health
- DOI: 10.1088/3049-477X/ae91ef

## Evidence boundary

- Audited task: REALDISP, ideal placement, right-thigh IMU, 50 Hz.
- Channels: ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz.
- Activities: codes 1, 3, 4, 33 mapped to walking, running, jump_up, cycling.
- Subjects: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16.
- Cross-validation: leave-one-subject-out; main window/hop: 160/40 samples.
- Config values are compatibility defaults, not an exact reproduction claim.

## Important files

- `README.md`: scope and setup.
- `configs/paper/`: three portable YAML variants.
- `src/lrf_imu/`: configuration and path primitives.
- `docs/`: audit, discrepancy, data, model, and reproducibility records.
- `tests/test_no_absolute_paths.py`: safety scanner.

## Not included

REALDISP data, derived windows, checkpoints, synthetic caches, result files,
scientific model/preprocessing/generation/evaluation code, logs, manuscript
history, review material, and a license grant are outside this milestone.
